change_reason: HVA-only RF support, rank, and same-cell pilot resolved before hierarchy inference
population: HVA-only local shared RF support with five-cell recording/category floor
unadjusted_model: weighted least squares: intercept + signed hierarchy score + session fixed nuisance effects
adjusted_model: unadjusted model + shared five-term quadratic RF surface
weighting: equal areas; equal animals within area; equal recordings within area/animal; equal cells within recording
estimands: response change across observed hierarchy-score range
bootstrap: paired whole-animal resampling; same multiplicities for adjusted and unadjusted fits
interpretation: statistical conditional sharing, not causal mediation; significance transitions are not attenuation tests
